# `lakana query`

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from the Typer app. Do not edit by hand:
run `uv run python scripts/generate_reference.py` and commit the result. -->

Part of the [Command line reference](../cli.md), which lists the options for every command.

Usage: `lakana query [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Submit queries and fetch their results step by step.

## `lakana query list`

Usage: `lakana query list [OPTIONS]`

List the queued and running queries of an environment.

Running queries come first, then queued ones in the order they will be taken, with the reason each waits. You see your own queries; with MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT on the environment, everyone's, and --submitter narrows them to one principal's. --all-environments lists every environment you may query at once. The SQL and the error text are not listed: read them with 'lakana query status ID'. A long list prints a "More results" line with the command that shows the next page.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
| `--all-environments` | flag | off | The queries of every environment you may query, with an environment column. |
| `--all` | flag | off | Also the queries that ended in the last 24 hours (or since --since). |
| `--status` | text, repeatable | none | Only queries in this status: queued, running, succeeded, failed or cancelled. Repeat the option or separate the values with commas. An ended status lists the ended queries of the last 24 hours (or since --since) without --all. |
| `--submitter` | text | none | Only the queries this principal submitted. |
| `--origin` | text, repeatable | none | Only queries from here: written, preview, check, write, maintenance or task. Repeat the option or separate the values with commas. |
| `--since` | text | none | List the queries that ended at or after this date or time (2026-10-18 or 2026-10-18T09:30:00Z, local time without a zone), of any age, instead of the last 24 hours; implies --all. |
| `--limit` | whole number, 1 to 200 | `100` | Most queries to list. |
| `--cursor` | text | none | Continue after the page that printed this cursor. |

## `lakana query submit`

Usage: `lakana query submit [OPTIONS] {query}`

Submit SQL without waiting; prints the query id.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `QUERY` | text | required |  |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |

## `lakana query status`

Usage: `lakana query status [OPTIONS] {query_id}`

Show a query's status; for a queued query, waiting_for says why it has not started.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `QUERY_ID` | text | required |  |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |

## `lakana query wait`

Usage: `lakana query wait [OPTIONS] {query_id}`

Wait for a query to finish.

After 3 seconds in the queue, a line on standard error says why the query waits ('Waiting: ...'), and again when the reason changes. Ctrl-C cancels the query, also one of someone else's if you hold MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `QUERY_ID` | text | required |  |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
| `--timeout` | number | none | Seconds to wait before giving up. |

## `lakana query cancel`

Usage: `lakana query cancel [OPTIONS] {query_id}`

Cancel a queued query, or ask the worker to stop a running one.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `QUERY_ID` | text | required |  |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |

## `lakana query result`

Usage: `lakana query result [OPTIONS] {query_id}`

Fetch a finished query's result.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `QUERY_ID` | text | required |  |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
| `--out` | path | none | Write the full result to this file. |
| `--format` | text | none | parquet, csv, arrow or xlsx (default: from the extension). |
| `--max-rows` | whole number, 0 or more | `50` | Most rows to display. |

## `lakana query saved`

Usage: `lakana query saved [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Save queries under a name, keep them private or share them with an environment.

### `lakana query saved create`

Usage: `lakana query saved create [OPTIONS] {name} {query}`

Save a query under NAME; it is private unless you pass --everyone.

Saving does not run the query. Whoever runs it later does so with their own rights.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | text | required | The name: one line, unique among your queries. |
| `QUERY` | text | required | The SQL, or - to read it from stdin. |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
| `--everyone` | flag | off | Share it with everyone who may run queries in the environment. |

### `lakana query saved list`

Usage: `lakana query saved list [OPTIONS]`

List the saved queries you see in an environment, by name or by --sort and --order.

You see your own, and those shared with everyone who may run queries in the environment. The SQL is not listed: read it with 'lakana query saved show ID'.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
| `--all-environments` | flag | off | The saved queries of every environment you may query, with an environment column. |
| `--limit` | whole number, 1 to 200 | `50` | Most saved queries to list. |
| `--cursor` | text | none | Continue after the page that printed this cursor. |
| `--sort` | text | none | What to sort by: name (the default), updated or created (the latest first). |
| `--order` | text | none | asc or desc; without it, the direction each --sort field has by default. |

### `lakana query saved show`

Usage: `lakana query saved show [OPTIONS] {ID}`

Show a saved query: its fields, then its SQL.

With --sql only the SQL is printed, so 'lakana query saved show ID --sql | lakana sql -' runs it. If the SQL holds control or invisible characters (a CRLF line ending is not one), --sql prints nothing and exits 1, as printing it escaped would run another query; read it with --output json, where --sql prints only {"sql": ...}. An administrator may not read the SQL of someone else's private query without READ_QUERY_TEXT; the command then says so.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | text | required | The saved query's id. |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
| `--sql` | flag | off | Print only the SQL, to pipe into 'lakana sql -'. |

### `lakana query saved update`

Usage: `lakana query saved update [OPTIONS] {ID}`

Change the name, the SQL or the visibility of a saved query you own.

The command reads the saved query first and sends every field, so what you leave out stays as it is.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | text | required | The saved query's id. |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
| `--name` | text | none | The new name. |
| `--sql` | text | none | The new SQL, or - to read it from stdin. |
| `--private` | flag | off | Make it private. |
| `--everyone` | flag | off | Share it with everyone who may run queries. |

### `lakana query saved delete`

Usage: `lakana query saved delete [OPTIONS] {ID}`

Delete a saved query: its owner may, and so may an administrator.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | text | required | The saved query's id. |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
| `--yes` | flag | off | Don't ask for confirmation. |
